capabilities.native_launch: OS initializes enough to discover LROS and enter cartridge; this is not independently guaranteed by a passive ROM.
capabilities.rom_execution: CPU and cartridge fetch path usable; appropriate low/high ROM anchor selected.
capabilities.home_mapping: ROM execution plus HOME RAM target exposed; memory contents are not presumed correct.
capabilities.qualified_workspace: One or more explicitly tested HOME blocks with safe mapping, guarded stack and state; display not automatically qualified.
capabilities.qualified_gateway: Tested HOME opcode block and verified copy of bounded gateway/checker; its chunk remains HOME.
capabilities.usable_display: Qualified workspace plus verified relevant HOME bitmap/attribute ranges; output requires visual judgement.
capabilities.qualified_interrupts: Tested stack/vector/ROM ISR and bounded interrupt checks passed; safe shadow protocol.
capabilities.external_instrument: Technician probe/logic analyzer fixture; any firmware-specific prerequisites still apply.
capabilities.ay_registers_qualified: AUD-02 passed meaningful masked reads; does not establish analog audio operation.
capabilities.cassette_setup: User selected cassette test and configured suitable recorder/coupling adapter; appropriate display/workspace gated separately.
capabilities.joystick_setup: User selected attached joystick and AY port A is configured as input.
capabilities.picovideo_profile: Explicitly selected PicoVideo board/firmware with verified port/mode capabilities, qualified display ranges and operator viewing external output; no blind probing.
capabilities.tspico_sram_profile: Operator-selected, verified TSPico board/firmware; SRAM selector/stride/reserved ranges and physical cartridge arbitration established; stable independent opcode anchor, sacrificial range and recovery mapping. Development builds permitted; reported version strings are informational only and never authorize probes.
capabilities.home_reset_rom: CPU/reset/HOME ROM fetch path and SCLD HOME decode usable; correct16KiB diagnostic installed at U16 with verified electrical adapter. No stockOS, DOCK, EXROM contents or RAM initialization assumed.

recovery_profiles.rom_only: Keep DI/no stack, emit bounded border/beeper report and direct-jump to the next safe ROM phase.
recovery_profiles.abandon_stack: Retain compact first-fault data in registers; direct-jump to ROM recovery, DI; never RET through suspect RAM; rebuild only qualified state.
recovery_profiles.mapping_restore: Finish bounded batch if safe, DI, restore known software-shadow mapping with active ROM anchor, report first mismatch.
recovery_profiles.gateway_restore: Stay in qualified HOME gateway, clear HSR, select DOCK in DECR, select anchor and JP to fixed ROM entry; no ROM return until visible.
recovery_profiles.interrupt_restore: DI, inhibit DECR interrupts, restore known ROM mapping through fixed checkpoints and discard unsafe return state; qualify any optional stack before later use.
recovery_profiles.video_restore: Leave target memory before redraw; restore documented mode0,anchor mapping and DI/inhibit; border report then rebuild qualified display.
recovery_profiles.audio_restore: Mute AY amplitudes, preserve/input-safe R7, lower FE speaker/tape bits, restore mapping; report with remaining qualified outputs.
recovery_profiles.soak_recovery: Latch first fault and partial-phase status; pause/stop at safe boundary; no BASIC return; fall back through fixed ROM JP if state/stack fails.
recovery_profiles.picovideo_restore: ROM-bounded profile-specific palette disable/known recovery palette as needed; restore native mode0 and intended mapping/DI; never wait for external video to resume.

tests.name: Native entry and resource baseline
tests.algorithm: Native LROS stackless entry, DI/known ports and cartridge integrity before RAM; passive OS handoff remains required. Power-on then selects quick00/FF full48K coverage only (phase2 stop); extended RAM is manual. New key after release cancels safely; menu explicitly marks startup limited. Held R/F explicitly chooses complete RAM/normal Full after narrow keyboard checks; finite highlighted status page, no dependency on release, broad all-low matrix rejects extended selection. Every boot choice now runs a separate minimal ROM0 register/arithmetic/shift consistency check before any HOME writes; mismatches repeat8/stage1-3 without display or keyboard. Default quick00/FF success adds qualified55/AA opposing HOME address pairs. Passive launch dependency remains.
tests.observables: Expected/observed comparisons where applicable; first failure and affected bit/path; user judgement separate for physical sound/video.
tests.failure_interpretation: An absent marker cannot uniquely identify CPU, ROM, RAM or SCLD failure.

tests.name: Register and instruction consistency
tests.algorithm: Executable five-stage ROM2 subset: complementary general-register values; arithmetic/carry/zero/sign/overflow examples and logic; shifts/bit ops; EXX and AF exchange; IX/IY byte/inc/dec (includes original NMOS undocumented index-byte operations). Checkpoint8/stage, mismatch8/stage, no RAM/stack control. Not exhaustive instruction/flags certification. Additional always-selected ROM0 boot subset checks general-register constants, arithmetic/carry/zero/sign/overflow/AND/XOR and rotate/shift/carry. No optional ROM2 transfer at boot. Detected boot faults repeat8/stage1-3 until reset.
tests.observables: Pre-stage8/stage border/beeper checkpoints; detected failure repeats8/stage1-5; matched result on completion. No full register dump. Cartridge guide explains each checkpoint and limits before CPU execution.
tests.failure_interpretation: Failure identifies exercised instruction/path; passing does not certify all Z80 behavior.

tests.name: Localized HOME address-pair consistency
tests.algorithm: For A0-A15 probe HOME pairs differing in one address bit,55/AA and reversedAA/55; first mismatch repeats9 then bit+1. ROM2 calls a fixed low-ROM bridge to expose all HOME RAM without RAM control or a stack. Default boot additionally qualifies each endpoint55/AA, then reads opposing55/AA and reversedAA/55 writes across16 pairs. Qualifier mismatches preserve normal RAM chip/address/expected/observed reporting; pair mismatches repeat9/index1-16 fromROM0 until reset. Only after a successful quick sweep.
tests.observables: Detected mismatch repeats9/bit-index1-16 (A0-A15); first failing pair stops, no screen/RAM state dependency for pulse control.
tests.failure_interpretation: Suspect address/data/mux/decoder/storage path, not proof of a Z80 pin or uniquely failed component; only16 selected pairs, complemented by full48K address patterns.

tests.name: Combined overnight mixed load
tests.algorithm: Configurable ROM-only mixed-load batches: all48K address-hash/March and data-only PUSH/POP, ECM fetch, fixed DOCK signature/isolation traffic, normal-refresh spacing, bounded IM1 entry and frequent synthetic Speech2AY-style R0-R12 writes/readbacks. Menu groups N/C as configurable duration before Begin test with S/R; the selected complete duration phrase is green. Option4 explicitly names60Hz screen interrupts; S uses bounded checkpoints and R confirms actual IRQ returns. Option6 now cycles quiet/busy slices, adds checked00/FF/55/AA traffic after hash comparisons, rotates0/2/6 video when option3 is enabled, and strengthens AY to14 writes with maximum/envelope amplitudes plus bounded beeper when option7 is enabled. tests.name: Resource permissions and fallback reporting
tests.algorithm: Stackless menus/control with bounded press-edge quarantine for held numeric and optional keys; RAM error unions select degraded display, M acknowledges faults for independent modules; optional CRC qualifies code/gateway; IRQ uses a write-only saved-PC sink. Active tests use all-key release plus any-key stop; result screens accept any key; keyboard holds CAPS+SPACE or ENTER+SPACE. A stuck initial contact can prevent the broad stop channel arming. Startup selection/progress legends; steady RAM phase border colors without mid-sweep display writes; reporter R retry also requires release/new press. Embedded cartridge font, no live HOME font reads. Help C provides explicit TRAINING: finite synthetic sync/2/6/2 RAM, bank4 and CPU8/3 examples using shared stackless ROM pulse routines; M returns to Help. No fault state or optional CPU test is entered. ROM0 boot fault pulses require neither display nor keyboard. Font bytes now reside inDOCK ROM1 at2200-24FF; ROM0 rich renderers selectHSR03 briefly and restore01. Minimal pulses and attribute-coded degraded glyphs do not depend on font data. Mixed-case menus/instructions use existing embedded96-character TS2068 font; host-only asset case conversion preserves hardware/key identifiers and original author spelling. No additional font storage or live HOME font lookup. Menu1 Full coverage overview uses bounded selection quarantine; new1 starts, M returns, startupF remains direct. Keyboard end on selector7 presents fullsummary: automatic RAM/bank/AY matches, user-observation requirements and exclusions. Held exit chord is captured/excluded until a new input edge. Cancellation and faults do not show completion; keyboard timeout is not key certification. Fixed ROM screen assets show nominal-clock duration estimates: RAM options84/41/8/8/3/24sec; Full4min to keyboard/8min including timeout; startupR1.5min, F4/8min; keyboard4min timeout; beeper15sec, AY22sec; overnight1.5min/pass until stopped. These are model-derived hints, not timers or completion evidence; no control budgets changed. Fault pulse pacing now uses sync-following silence0.89s, intra-group silence0.41s and inter-group silence1.30s at nominal3.528MHz; longsync1.18s/153Hz and counting0.595s/429Hz, with approximately2.8:1 pitch separation. Shared code/train waits remain bounded in ROM, no RAM or interrupts. Selector0 Complete RAM success now loads rampass with All6 RAM chips PASS and all six designators, then reuses Full summary new-key quarantine. Error masks are checked before this dispatch. Quick/partial/full/soak/IRQ selectors remain separate and cancellations cannot show it. RAM menu states chip-identification capability. Individual RAM successes show Selected checks PASS; complete RAM shows All 6 RAM chips PASS. Shared pass_ready/fullsummary_ready input guard requires a fresh key. Cancellation does not claim success and mismatches enter the chip/bit reporter.

tests.name: TSPico external SRAM and slot isolation
tests.algorithm: Opt-in exact-profile SRAM patterns/walking/March/address/random/soak; establish slot overlap with unique signatures, protect diagnostic image and runtime areas, keep immutable execution anchor, bounded mapping and recovery. No external SRAM code or probes implemented. Use verified capability profiles independent of displayed version, supporting developmental firmware; unsupported capabilities skip without speculative writes.
tests.observables: Planned physical slot/verified offset, logical address, expected/observed, XOR mask and first-fault pulses; not currently executable.
tests.failure_interpretation: TSPico SRAM U13 (board prefix required), selector, bus/decoder/interface path; not a HOME DRAM chip verdict. Slot overlap must be established before claiming capacity coverage.

tests.name: U16 HOME-ROM reset diagnostic bootstrap
tests.algorithm: 16KiB U16 image beginsJP entry at0000; DI/known DECR40 andHSR00, early register/math/shift checks, full-image additive16-bit integrity beforeRAM, boundedR/F selector, quick48K00/FF plus qualified55/AA alias pairs. CompleteRAM/HOME Full/audio/keyboard/joystick/IRQ subset; no stockOS/DOCK/EXROM contents. Native HOME control remains stackless; minimal faults are border/beeper, no large degraded glyph renderer.
tests.observables: Reset status/menu, audible RAM chip/bit codes, CPU8/stage, address9/index, integrity3, explicit completeRAM result. HOME Full coverage differs from cartridge Full.
tests.failure_interpretation: Bypasses OS RAM/ROM/cartridge-launch failures; still requires HOME decode, CPU clock/reset/fetch and shared buses. Silent/frozen machine cannot identify a component. OriginalU16 removed, cannot checksum it in this profile.

tests.name: Sinistar stack-data load reproduction
tests.algorithm: Real PUSH DE/POP BC data-only pairs sweep every byte4000-FFFF using address-derived complementary bytes; D1-rich data and5ED0/BFFF vicinity included. DI pairs; enabled loads interleave every256 bytes. Popped data never chooses PC/SP/continuation; fixed SP reset and ROM JP recovery. Recovery latches the original observed POP/read byte through compare_observed, avoiding a second RAM read that could erase transient faults. Exact XOR masks for D0-D7 and multibit26h are verified in each RAM region.
tests.observables: First RAM address/expected/observed/XOR region mask/phase and chip/bit pulses; auxiliary4/5/7 class/address-or-index/expected/observed/phase. No-fault stopped batch count wraps65536. Fault fields replace batch count; no persistent log. Analog output needs observation.
tests.failure_interpretation: Low-nibble RAM/shared data/write/read/timing/supply paths; no unique component verdict. Isolated reruns required for combined failures.

validation_evidence.configuration: TSRun mapped64K DOCK; all256 safe slice masks, representative batches, D1 POP data loss, missing IRQ/bank/AY faults, UI cancellation and real IM1/IM2 return profiles. Physical timing/supply/thermal replication pending.
